Take turns whenever you like. Open the game from the home page any time to see if it's your move.

How to play

  • Take turns tapping a column to drop a counter. It falls to the lowest empty space.
  • Get four of your colour in a row (across, down or corner to corner) to win the round.
  • Fill the whole page with no four in a row and it's a draw.
  • Who goes first swaps every round.
